Organisation: Coastal Managed IT (fictional SME) — default-MFA posture model
Ethics: Assessment names bypass CLASSES only. No tooling, payloads, or reproduction procedures.

Classes.AttckHint: Credential Access — valid accounts via legacy protocols
Classes.WhyOpen: MFA often does not apply to legacy mail protocols; many SMEs leave them enabled.
User can approve a malicious app after MFA; tenant consent policies often unrestricted.

Classes.AttckHint: Credential Access — steal application access token
Classes.WhyOpen: MFA protects interactive sign-in, not a stolen refresh token until revoked or Conditional Access binds device/risk.

Classes.Class: Weak MFA methods (SMS / voice / push fatigue)
Classes.AttckHint: Credential Access — MFA fatigue / SIM-related risks (high-level)
Classes.WhyOpen: Default MFA methods may be phishing-susceptible; phishing-resistant methods not required.

Classes.Class: Persistent browser sessions on unmanaged devices
Classes.AttckHint: Defense Evasion / Credential Access — session reuse
Classes.WhyOpen: No device compliance or sign-in frequency controls on Free tier / defaults.
Emergency accounts excluded from MFA with weak monitoring create a standing bypass.
